themes.description: Grouping movers into stories without inventing names

first_output.what: New semiconductor export controls pressured chipmakers, with memory and AI chips facing tighter restrictions on sales to certain markets. All three major chip names fell together as investors priced in potential revenue headwinds from reduced access to key international customers.
Eli Lilly surged on positive clinical trial results for its obesity treatment, beating expectations and reinforcing the company's competitive position in the weight-loss drug market.
